# Echo inventory (line-edit Stage 0 harvest)

*Generated by `tools/echo_harvest.py` over 57 scene files (~181,809 words). Mechanical and over-inclusive by design — every item is a candidate, not a finding. Whether an echo is a seeded thread (PROTECTED), an accident (FIX-AT), or noise (IGNORE) is an authorial ruling recorded in `audits/line-edit/echo-rulings.md`; this file regenerates and holds no decisions.*
